name: vrs-standing-data
what_it_holds: Route/airline/airport 'standing data' from the Virtual Radar Server project -- per-callsign route lookups (JSON, e.g. routes/IT/ITY110.json) plus consolidated CSV files for routes and airports, served via GitHub Pages and refreshed hourly (CC0-1.0, 25 commits).
why_useful: A free, hourly-refreshed callsign-to-route lookup table; useful as a join layer for any ADS-B-derived flight counting work but does not itself carry capacity or volume figures.
size_hint: small; per-callsign JSON + CSV route/airport tables
themes: Flight tracking and schedules: OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange, FlightRadar scrapers, aviationstack samples, airline seat capacity by route
why_all: A free, hourly-refreshed callsign-to-route lookup table; useful as a join layer for any ADS-B-derived flight counting work but does not itself carry capacity or volume figures.

name: FiledRoutesDB
what_it_holds: Planned dataset of filed flight-plan route pairs (callsign to origin/destination, US air traffic system only) intended to be rebuilt weekly from FAA data, excluding LADD-listed aircraft. As of this check the repo explicitly states 'Nothing is published yet. This repository holds no data' pending FAA clarification on redistribution terms. MIT licensed, 2 commits.
why_useful: Not usable today -- flagged only because if/when published it would be a free weekly US route-pair dataset; worth a re-check in a future sweep, not actionable now.
themes: Flight tracking and schedules: OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange, FlightRadar scrapers, aviationstack samples, airline seat capacity by route
why_all: Not usable today -- flagged only because if/when published it would be a free weekly US route-pair dataset; worth a re-check in a future sweep, not actionable now.

name: flightdelay-dbt-warehouse
what_it_holds: A dbt/DuckDB dimensional warehouse built on the classic nycflights13 dataset (336,776 NYC-area departures in calendar 2013 from EWR/JFK/LGA) plus OurAirports (86,013 rows) and OpenFlights (6,162 airline rows) as dimension sources.
why_useful: Low incremental value -- nycflights13 is a single US market, single year (2013), already-stale teaching dataset; flagged only because it packages OurAirports+OpenFlights joins cleanly, which the other two entries above already cover better.
duplicate_of_holding: OurAirports and OpenFlights entries above; nycflights13 itself is too old/narrow to be useful
themes: Flight tracking and schedules: OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange, FlightRadar scrapers, aviationstack samples, airline seat capacity by route
why_all: Low incremental value -- nycflights13 is a single US market, single year (2013), already-stale teaching dataset; flagged only because it packages OurAirports+OpenFlights joins cleanly, which the other two entries above already cover better.

name: euctrl-pru/OPDI (Open Performance Data Initiative)
what_it_holds: Python ETL pipeline (9 stages) pulling raw ADS-B state vectors from OpenSky Network S3, aircraft metadata, and OurAirports reference data; generates H3 geospatial reference grids; exports to parquet/CSV.gz on Azure Iceberg/S3. No committed processed datasets themselves; official EUROCONTROL org repo tied to opdi-portal (public data initiative).
why_useful: Method to reconstruct flight-level European air traffic (route, airport pairs) from raw ADS-B if a real point-in-time European travel-demand series is needed; heavier lift than a stored dataset but a credible, non-terms-of-service-violating pipeline.
size_hint: pipeline code only, no data committed (references a ~35GB external OSM extract not tracked)
themes: European and global aviation stats: Eurocontrol, EASA, ACI airport passenger stats, IATA public figures, airport monthly traffic scrapers (Heathrow, Schiphol, ADP, Fraport, AENA)
why_all: Method to reconstruct flight-level European air traffic (route, airport pairs) from raw ADS-B if a real point-in-time European travel-demand series is needed; heavier lift than a stored dataset but a credible, non-terms-of-service-violating pipeline.

Could be used to derive flight-count-by-airport time series as an alternate traffic proxy, but requires running the pipeline against OpenSky's raw archive (heavy compute, no committed output dataset) - a method, not a ready dataset; lower immediate usefulness than daio or eurostat.

name: euctrl-pru/data-app_website
what_it_holds: Website/front-end for the official EUROCONTROL 'Data App' (dashboard at eurocontrol.int/dashboard) -- points to EUROCONTROL's own hosted traffic/statistics dashboards rather than storing data in-repo.
why_useful: Confirms EUROCONTROL's own public Data App (traffic counts, delay stats by state/airport) as an external source; not itself a dataset but documents the sanctioned public data surface for European air traffic, worth a manual pull if European travel-volume proxy is prioritized.
themes: European and global aviation stats: Eurocontrol, EASA, ACI airport passenger stats, IATA public figures, airport monthly traffic scrapers (Heathrow, Schiphol, ADP, Fraport, AENA)
